messages:
maya: Quick design QA — retention slider in the Dataset retention modal is skipping when tabbing. Steps: Open modal -> Tab through controls -> slider isn't focusable. Screen reader reads 'Range' but no value announced. Link: https://staging.redwood.io/s/12345
sam: I can repro. Looks like the custom slider is missing role=\"slider\" and aria-valuenow binding. Also tabindex might be -1 by default.
andre: Noted. Also noticed the help text: 'Data retention applies to user content' — that feels vague. Should call out logs vs files?
olivia: Agree on labelled copy. Suggest: 'Automatically delete stored data (user content and logs) after the selected period.' Shorter and clearer.
ben: Minor surrounding nit: audit log CSV header currently uses 'event_time' but UI shows 'Time (UTC)'. Which one do we standardize on for exports?
maya: Prefer 'timestamp' ISO8601 across UI + CSV. Current inconsistency causing mapping pain for analytics.
sam: Plan: add role=slider, aria-label=\"Retention period (days)\", aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax, and update aria-valuenow on change. Will also ensure keyboard handling for arrow keys.
andre: We also need a visible focus ring on the slider thumb (high contrast). Current CSS tokens for focus-outline are missing in this component.
olivia: For screen readers, also set aria-valuetext to something like '30 days' so it's human-friendly.
maya: On layout: product asked region selector be above KMS toggle in modal. Legal prefers KMS visibility earlier for BYOK flows. Any objections?
ben: Legal's perspective makes sense, but putting region above KMS helps reduce accidental BYOK selection. Could we reorder but add a small hint near KMS: 'Used for customer-managed keys (BYOK) — region must match key location.'
prodbot: Deploy scheduled: staging rollout for retention slider keyboard fixes on 2025-12-15T09:30:00Z.
sam: Opening PR with implementation snippet for accessibility:
```
<input role=\"slider\" aria-valuemin=\"0\" aria-valuemax=\"365\" aria-valuenow=\"30\" aria-valuetext=\"30 days\" tabindex=\"0\"> 
```
I'll include keyboard arrow handlers.
olivia: Also propose microcopy tweak for the modal header and tooltip: header line 'Data retention' -> 'Retention period' (noun clarity). Tooltip: 'Data is removed after X days' -> 'Automatically delete user and system data after X days.'
andre: Audit events need clearer verbs. Current: 'Key rotation requested by user@example.com' -> prefer 'KMS key rotation initiated by user@example.com' to standardize on 'initiated' for system events.
maya: Let's split tasks: sam = slider + focus ring PR, ben = audit CSV header rename & infra note, olivia = copy pass for modal + tooltips, andre = audit event phrasing pass, me (maya) = update design spec and create acceptance criteria.
ben: Filing tiny ticket for CSV header standardization: #UI-9876 (will link to PR).
maya: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Slider fully keyboard operable (tab, arrows, page up/down), 2) Screen readers announce value and unit, 3) Visible focus ring matches accessibility tokens, 4) Modal copy updated and doc link included, 5) Exported CSV header uses 'timestamp' ISO8601.
sam: I'll add unit tests for keyboard handlers and axe-ci checks.
olivia: I'll also add copy variants for localization QA (short vs long strings).
andre: For audit logs, I'll prepare mapping table for event names and suggested canonical wording in the spec doc.
maya: Thanks everyone — I'll gather these into a single PR checklist and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
ben: Appreciate it.
maya: closing loop: will review PRs together and mark for staging verification after prodbot deploy. :white_check_mark:
